title: Notifications
description: Where Orbit sends alerts, what the messages say, who gets them first and who is on call.
readOnly: Notifications can only be changed on the machine that runs Orbit.
loadFailed: Couldn't load this list. Check that Orbit is running, then try again.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Each channel receives the incidents of the groups you choose.
channels.emptyBody: Add a channel so Orbit can tell you when something breaks — Slack, Teams, e-mail, Telegram, WhatsApp or a webhook.
channels.caption: Notification channels
channels.deleteBody: Orbit stops sending alerts to this channel. Escalation steps that use it skip it.

form.name: Name
form.enabledHint: Turn off to pause it without losing the settings.
form.noGroups: No groups yet. The channel will receive every incident.
form.webhookHint: Paste the URL from the channel's incoming webhook settings. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.webhookHintStored: Stored encrypted. Leave empty to keep it, or paste a new URL to replace it.
form.signingSecretHint: Orbit signs each request with HMAC-SHA256 so your endpoint can check it came from Orbit.
form.botApiHint: Only for a self-hosted Bot API. Leave empty to use api.telegram.org.
form.chatIdsHint: One per line. Send /start to the bot, then use the chat id it reports.
form.phonesHint: One per line, with country code: +5511912345678.
form.providerTemplateHint: Needed to start conversations on the WhatsApp Business API. Leave empty to send plain text.
form.recipientsStored_one: {{count}} recipient stored ({{list}}). Leave empty to keep them, or type the full list to replace it.
form.recipientsStored_other: {{count}} recipients stored ({{list}}). Leave empty to keep them, or type the full list to replace it.
form.secretStored: Stored encrypted. Leave empty to keep it.

errors.name: Give the channel a name.
errors.url: Paste the URL Orbit should send to.
errors.urlFormat: Use a full address starting with https://.
errors.token: Paste the token from the provider.
errors.emailFormat: Check the addresses: one valid e-mail per line.
errors.phoneFormat: Use international numbers with + and country code, like +5511912345678.
errors.smtpHost: Enter the SMTP server, like smtp.example.com.
errors.smtpFrom: Enter the address messages are sent from.
errors.groups: Choose at least one group, or send all groups.

failures.title: Delivery failures
failures.description: Messages that could not be delivered after every retry. The list is kept until Orbit restarts.
failures.emptyBody: When a channel rejects or can't receive a message, it shows up here with the reason.
failures.caption: Undelivered messages

templates.title: Messages
templates.description: The text Orbit sends for each event. Change the wording per language; reset brings back the default.
templates.caption: Message templates
templates.resetBody: Your wording is removed in every language and Orbit goes back to the default text.

form.subject: Subject
form.variablesHint: Write placeholders like {{example}}; Orbit fills them in when it sends.

templates.previewHint: Sample incident, with sensitive values masked like real messages. Shows the saved text.

escalation.title: Escalation policies
escalation.description: If nobody acknowledges an incident, Orbit notifies more people step by step.
escalation.emptyBody: Add a policy so unacknowledged incidents reach a manager or the on-call person after a few minutes.
escalation.caption: Escalation policies
escalation.deleteBody: Open incidents in its groups stop escalating.

upcoming.title: Next escalations
upcoming.description: Open incidents nobody has acknowledged yet.

form.name: Name
form.stepsHint: Minutes are counted from when the incident opened.
form.noChannels: Add a channel first — the step has nowhere to send.

errors.name: Give the policy a name.
errors.after: Use 0 or more minutes, increasing step by step.
errors.target: Pick a channel for each step.
errors.groups: Choose at least one group, or apply to all groups.

oncall.title: On-call schedules
oncall.description: People take turns; Orbit names who is on call in alerts, escalation messages and on the wall.
oncall.emptyBody: Add a rotation so alerts can say who is on call right now.
oncall.caption: On-call schedules
oncall.deleteBody: Escalation steps that name this schedule stop naming anyone.
oncall.nowEmpty: Nobody is on call right now.

form.name: Name
form.peopleHint: One name per line. The first person starts the rotation.
form.startHint: Local time. Shifts follow on from here.
form.overridesKept_one: {{count}} shift swap is kept as it is.
form.overridesKept_other: {{count}} shift swaps are kept as they are.

problems.refused: Couldn't connect. Check the address and that this machine can reach it.
problems.unknownHost: That host name doesn't exist. Check the address.
problems.timeout: The service took too long to answer.
problems.tls: The secure connection failed (certificate or TLS settings).
problems.auth: The service refused the credentials. Check the token or password.
problems.http: The service answered HTTP {{status}}. Check the address and token.
